text:
lee: Heads up, customer on Vercel hit a hard error importing @redwood/inference-sdk@0.12.3 in an Edge function: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. They only do `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'`.

sarah: Do we have the package manifest that was published?

lee: Pasted the package.json from their installed tarball:```
{name: "@redwood/inference-sdk", version: "0.12.3", main: "dist/index.cjs", module: "dist/index.mjs", exports: { ".": { "require": "dist/index.cjs", "import": "dist/index.cjs.mjs" } }, types: "dist/index.d.ts"}
```

sarah: That's the problem. `import` target is `dist/index.cjs.mjs` — double-extension. ESM resolver tries to load that exact file and fails.

lee: I unpacked their npm pack and indeed the tarball contains `dist/index.cjs.mjs` (weird) and no `dist/index.mjs` or `dist/index.d.ts`.

tim: Sounds like our build pipeline appended `.mjs` after the `cjs` artifact in a transform step. We probably run a plugin to rewrite entries for edge builds and it ran on the wrong file.

sarah: Immediate remediation: we should publish 0.12.4 with corrected exports mapping to `./dist/index.mjs` and include types + sourcemaps. Also deprecate 0.12.3 with a message pointing to the fixed version.

lee: For the affected customer, quick workaround is to import deep path: `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/index.mjs'` if they can patch. Not ideal.

tim: Long term fix: add a release-step validation that runs `npm pack` and verifies every path listed in package.json (main/module/exports/types) exists in the tarball. Fail release if any target missing or contains suspicious patterns like `*.cjs.mjs`.

sarah: Also enable emitting source maps for published builds so customers can get proper stack traces when rolling.

ops-bot: Release job report: missing files in tarball ["dist/index.mjs","dist/index.d.ts"], unexpected file found ["dist/index.cjs.mjs"]. Publish blocked.

lee: Good catch ops-bot. I'll file two PRs: 1) patch rollup/tsc publish so we don't double-append extensions and include types/sourcemaps, 2) CI release guard to inspect `npm pack`. Assigning to @tim for review.

tim: Will review. Also propose a tiny lint that scans emitted filenames for multiple extensions and fails build if found.

sarah: Add a short note in release checklist: run `npm pack` and run `tar -tf` to inspect tarball contents before publishing. We'll add automated check as well.

lee: Once 0.12.4 is published I'll post a deprecation message for 0.12.3 and ping the affected customer.

tim: Thanks. Postmortem item: "publish: double-extension exports -> ESM import failure". Link PRs and the CI test.

sarah: Closing when patch is live. :white_check_mark:
